messages:
ellie: quick drop: onboarding notes for nova-mini (new 8b candidate). ran fp16 / int6 / int4 on our standard GTN slices. attaching short scorecard and proposed routing.

ram: pls paste TL;DR numbers

ellie: TL;DR -> int6 gives best sweetspot for mixed workloads: ~55% cost reduction vs fp16 with <1% avg quality loss; int4 shows bigger cost wins but some regression on code-generation and multi-turn context. key table below.

ellie: 
```
slice        | config  | p50 ms | p95 ms | $/1M tok | quality delta (task acc)
chat         | fp16    | 45     | 140    | $12.0    | baseline
chat         | int6    | 40     | 120    | $6.0     | -0.5%
chat         | int4    | 42     | 180    | $3.2     | -1.8%
code-gen     | fp16    | 120    | 420    | $12.0    | baseline
code-gen     | int6    | 110    | 390    | $6.0     | -0.8%
code-gen     | int4    | 135    | 680    | $3.2     | -5.2%
longform sum | fp16    | 210    | 900    | $12.0    | baseline
longform sum | int6    | 190    | 820    | $6.0     | -1.6%
longform sum | int4    | 230    | 1050   | $3.2     | -6.7%
```
notes: int4 p95 tail balloons for >1500 token contexts (kv cache thrash + attention kernel mismatch). int6 looks stable and yields ~50% token-cost savings with modest quality impact.

diego: product asked if we can ship hybrid routing for GTN with a quick ROI calc. GTN ~5M tokens/day. what are monthly savings if we route 50% chat->int6 and 30% code->int6 (rest fp16)?

ellie: calc quick: fp16 baseline cost = 5M * $12 / 1M = $60/day -> monthly ~ $1.8k
blend day: chat50% int6 & code30% int6 (assume chat=60% of tokens, code=20%, other=20%)
- chat portion baseline = 0.6*5M = 3M tokens. moving 50% -> 1.5M @ int6 saves (1.5M*(12-6))/1M = $9/day
- code portion baseline = 1M tokens; moving 30% -> 0.3M @ int6 saves (0.3M*(12-6))/1M = $1.8/day
- total daily save ~ $10.8 -> monthly ~ $324
caveat: ignores embeddings/rlhf rerank overhead and traffic shape.

ram: ops plan + safety signals:
- canary 2% traffic int6 for 48h, monitor: task-accuracy, hallucination, latency p95, kv-evictions
- if any slice degrades >2% absolute -> pause
- for int4 we require a 14-day shadow run before traffic (too many tails)

product-lead: we need a short A/B script to validate UX. recommended metrics?
diego: A/B script idea: 10k users, 5k control (fp16), 5k treatment (hybrid routing int6), run 7 days. primary metric = task-complete rate; secondary = complaints per 1k, avg response latency. require no >1% drop in primary.

ellie: routing flags draft (console snippet):
```json
{
  "route_policy": "slice_based",
  "rules": [
    {"slice":"chat","model_variant":"nova-mini-int6","pct":50},
    {"slice":"code-gen","model_variant":"nova-mini-int6","pct":30},
    {"slice":"legal","model_variant":"nova-mini-fp16","pct":100}
  ],
  "fallback":"nova-mini-int6",
  "max_consecutive_failures":4
}
```
(we'll paste pretty version in the PR)

deploy-bot: Canary launched: nova-mini-int6 on redwood-ded-5, traffic=2%, owner=ram. Checks scheduled: accuracy-check, latency-check, kv-eviction-monitor.

ram: risk notes: int6 quantizer occasionally rewrites softmax scaling for certain layers; we saw one slice with tokenization mismatch when tokenizer-v2 is used. add tokenizer-v1 check in sentinel to avoid silent regressions.

ellie: next steps: I'll author a 1-page GTN handoff (scorecard + routing JSON + rollback checklist) and open the PR for the feature-flag. will also start a 14d shadow run for int4 but won't route traffic until we confirm tails.

diego: thanks. please post the PR link here when ready and tag #product. also add a short runbook line: "if user reports code-gen failures, flip code-gen to fp16 and escalate to eng-ml immediately".

iellie: done — PR drafted, tagging reviewers. will update after 48h canary. :white_check_mark:
